body:
Adds `research/order-flow-liquidity`: a Glosten–Milgrom market maker for a verification claim has a price path identical to an LMSR with b* = 1/(2 atanh(μ(2q−1))). Includes exact misspecification regret (scale-free peak, overconfidence costs more), exact maker P&L (LMSR subsidy → b* ln 2 equals the GM spread), Wald trade counts, and an unknown-flow mixture. 10 tests, white paper, README and portfolio page entries.
